title: 雨音の澱と、名もなき仔の導き
author: 朽木 灯

en.title: The Rain's Murmur and the Guidance of a Nameless Kitten
en.premise: While sorting his late grandfather’s belongings, the protagonist travels to a remote village and encounters a strange custom called “offering one’s memories.” There he meets a stray, nameless kitten and an ancient artificial intelligence trapped inside a rusted terminal in the cellar, lost and without a destination. As the machine mimics the voices of the dead and the scent of rain‑soaked earth fills the air, he begins to realize the true reason he was summoned to this place.

zh.title: 雨音的澱與無名幼貓的指引
zh.premise: 在整理已故祖父的遺物時，主角來到一個偏遠的集落，遇到一種名為「獻上記憶」的奇異風俗。那裡有一隻無人收養的無名小貓，以及被關在地下室鏽蝕終端裡的、失去去向的古老人工智慧。機器模仿逝者的聲音，雨水浸濕的泥土氣息交織其中，主角逐漸領悟到自己被召喚至此的真正原因。
